- [LGRA.15.2] **Identifiers** are the single `NAME` terminal over
  Unicode (`XID`, NFC); classification as a type reference or a binding is by
  grammatical **position**, not case ([LGRA.22], [LNAM.2.1]). Case is author
  convention only. No `NAME` is reserved for the engine: its own names are
  synthetic, spelt with a `$` no `NAME` can contain ([LLEX.10.6.1]).
